items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: They had a guy named Fess Duncan; Duncan Fess, they called him -- he was from New Orleans. Pretty good piano player.

ctx.x: too. I don't know if he had anybody in that band from New Orleans. But I couldn't remember... They had a guy named Fess Duncan; Duncan Fess, they called him -- he was from New Orleans. Pretty good piano player.
Ah, there's one New Orleans musician I've never heard of.
